entries.name: Iron Inquisition
entries.description: The church's hunters: bell sweeps, stockades and vivisection slabs; the Castellan Watch is its city arm.

entries.name: Castellan Watch
entries.description: The city watch: curfews, ward gates and Tithing sweeps under Inquisition writ.

entries.name: Tallow Guild
entries.description: Renders the district's Spent dead into Warded Tallow; its mercenaries scour the cellars.

entries.name: Fourth Kiln Syndicate
entries.description: The Guild's foundry arm: casts brass conduits and runs the bone-mill.
